passages.title: Should Teenagers Choose Their Own Clothes?
passages.body: Many teenagers think they should be allowed to choose their own clothes. They say it is a way to show who they are. But some parents do not agree. They worry that teenagers may make poor choices. In some schools, students are not allowed to wear their own clothes. They must wear a uniform instead. Some students think this is unfair. They believe they are old enough to decide. Other students like uniforms because they are easy and cheap. There is no simple answer. Perhaps the best way is for parents and teenagers to talk and find a choice that works for both.

passages.title: Liu Yu's Dream
passages.body: Liu Yu is a fifteen-year-old boy. He loves running and dreams of becoming a professional runner. He has trained hard since he was young. But his parents do not support his dream. They want him to study more and become a doctor. "Of course we want him to do well," says his mother. "But running is too risky." Liu Yu does not agree. He thinks he should be allowed to make his own decision. "If I am not allowed to follow my dream, I will regret it," he says. He hopes that one day his parents will understand and let him try.

passages.title: Part-Time Jobs for Teenagers
passages.body: In some countries, teenagers are allowed to have part-time jobs. They may work in shops or restaurants after school. Many people think this is a good idea. By working, teenagers can learn how to manage money and time. They also learn how to work with others. However, some parents do not agree. They worry that jobs will get in the way of study. They think school work should come first. Experts say part-time jobs can be helpful if teenagers do not work too many hours. The key is to find a good balance between study and work.

passages.title: Mom Knows Best
passages.body: When I was a small child, my mom held my hand when we crossed the road. When I was tired, she carried me. I thought she was too strict. When I was a teenager, I wanted to eat ice cream every day. But she said no. I was not allowed to stay up late or watch too much TV. I thought she did not understand me. Now I am older. I look back at those times. I know now that my mom always wanted the best for me. She was not being unkind. She was keeping me safe. Mom really does know best.

passages.title: Are School Uniforms a Good Idea?
passages.body: School uniforms are a hot topic. Should students be allowed to wear what they like, or should they wear uniforms? Those who like uniforms say they make students equal. No one is judged by their clothes. Uniforms also save time in the morning. But others think uniforms are boring. They believe students should be allowed to show their own style. Some say uniforms stop students from being creative. In many schools, students are not allowed to change their uniforms at all. Maybe schools could let students help design the uniforms. That way, both sides might be happy.

passages.title: School Rules Notice
passages.body: GREENWOOD SCHOOL — STUDENT RULES. Please read these rules carefully. IN CLASS: Students are not allowed to use mobile phones. Phones must be turned off. CLOTHES: Students should wear the school uniform every day. On sports day, students are allowed to wear sports clothes. LIBRARY: Students must be quiet. Eating and drinking are not allowed. SAFETY: Students are not allowed to leave school during the day without a note from a parent. CLUBS: All students are allowed to join one club after school. We hope these rules help everyone study and stay safe. Thank you for following them.
